lines.japanese: 「あ……あの、味噌汁おいしかったね」
lines.english: “Um... the miso soup was good.”

lines.japanese: 「お？　おお、そーな。ぬるくてごめんな」
lines.english: “Hm? Oh. Yeah. Sorry it was lukewarm.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、まー、べつに、あはは、たまにはいいよね、ぬるいのも」
lines.english: “Oh, well, that's okay. Ha ha. Lukewarm can be nice sometimes, right?”

lines.japanese: 「だよな。たまにはいいんだよな」
lines.english: “Yeah. Sometimes lukewarm is nice.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「おー」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: なんか重い。
lines.english: Something felt heavy.

lines.japanese: なんつうか空気が重い。
lines.english: The air, I mean. It was heavy.

lines.japanese: 漫画喫茶を出てから──いや、漫画喫茶の個室を出てから、俺たちはずっとこんな感じだった。
lines.english: Ever since we left the comic-book café—no, ever since we stepped out of its private booth—we’d been like this.

lines.japanese: なにが「最後までバカやれる仲」だ。明らかにギクシャクしてるじゃねえか。
lines.english: So much for being “two idiots who could keep fooling around together right to the end.” We couldn’t have been more awkward.

lines.japanese: でもやつは明らかに涙目で、明らかに空元気で、明らかにその原因は俺だっていうのに、どのツラ下げてバカ話をすりゃいいんだ。
lines.english: But her eyes were plainly wet, her cheer was plainly forced, and I was plainly the cause. How could I even look her in the eye and crack stupid jokes?

lines.japanese: 何事もなかったかのように……なんてそんな意識しているうちは、自然になんて振るまえないのかもしれない。
lines.english: Maybe as long as I was consciously trying to act as though nothing had happened, I would never manage to act naturally.

lines.japanese: だから俺は言ったんだ。ラインを超えるなって。
lines.english: That was why I'd told her not to cross that line.

lines.japanese: はあ、やだやだ、この空気。
lines.english: God, I hated this mood.

lines.japanese: 「あー、そーいやアレ、あのー、シート結構ふかふかだったな」
lines.english: “Oh, hey. Come to think of it, that seat was pretty plush.”

lines.japanese: 「あー！　そー！　だしょー、結構ふかふかだしょー！　ねー」
lines.english: “Oh! Yeah! Totally! It was pretty plush, wasn't it? Right?”

lines.japanese: 「なー」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「んー」
lines.english: “Mm.”

lines.japanese: いちいち下向くな。間を置くな。寂しげに微笑むな。おまえはそんなキャラじゃなかったろ香田亜衣。
lines.english: Stop looking down every five seconds. Stop leaving those silences. Stop smiling sadly. That was never your character, Ai Koda.

lines.japanese: <8>\　あああぁぁ！　もおおお、めんどくせえなあああああ！
lines.english: Gaaaaah! This was such a goddamn paaaain!

lines.japanese: 俺は音がするくらい盛大に、ごっしゃごっしゃと後ろ頭を掻きなぐった。その掻きっぷりたるや、擦れちがいざまの通行人がビビクンと漫画のような驚き方をするくらいだ。ざまあみろチクショウめが。
lines.english: I clawed at the back of my head, making a hell of a racket. A passerby flinched as he went past, like someone in a cartoon. Served him right. Damn it all.

lines.japanese: 「あ……ごめん……」
lines.english: “Oh... Sorry...”

lines.japanese: ついでに香田までビクつかせてしまった。何の「ごめん」だ、おまえ何も悪くねえだろ。
lines.english: Now I'd made Koda flinch too. What was she apologizing for? She hadn't done anything wrong.

lines.japanese: だめだ、今日はもういい。今日はもうここで解散しよう。
lines.english: No. Screw it. That's enough for today. Let's split up here.

lines.japanese: せめてもの罪滅ぼしに駅まで送っていこうと思ってたけど、やめだやめ、今日はもうここまでにしよう。
lines.english: I'd meant to walk her to the station as some small act of atonement, but forget it. Forget all of it. Today ended here.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ俺、そろそろ──」
lines.english: “Well, I should probably—”

lines.japanese: 「やだ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 言いかけたら香田に服を掴まれた。
lines.english: Before I could finish, Koda caught hold of my clothes.

lines.japanese: 「もうちょっといいじゃん」
lines.english: “Stay a little longer.”

lines.japanese: そんな俯いたまま言われても。そんな状態で一緒にいたって楽しくないだろ。
lines.english: Not when she asked with her head hanging like that. What fun would either of us have staying together like this?

lines.japanese: 俺はどう言って振りほどけば、少しでもやつの傷口を広げないで済むか考えていた。
lines.english: I was trying to figure out what I could say to shake her off without tearing the wound any wider than I had to.

lines.japanese: <8>\「ちゅーっす！」
lines.english: “Yo!”

lines.japanese: そのとき後ろから場違いな声をかけられた。
lines.english: At that moment, a spectacularly inappropriate voice called out behind us.

lines.japanese: 「あれあれェ～！　偶然ジャン、おふたりすゎ～ん！」
lines.english: “Well, well! Fancy running into you twooo!”

lines.japanese: 振りかえるとチャラい小僧がふたりいた。
lines.english: I turned to find two flashy young idiots standing there.

lines.japanese: 相変わらず空気も読まずにバカテンションのギャル男。退屈そうな表情の森里が、若干の距離を置いてその後ろに立っていた。
lines.english: The flashy idiot was his usual oblivious, wildly overexcited self. Morisato stood a little way behind him, looking bored.

lines.japanese: 「あ……ちょっす……」
気の置けない仲間と出くわしたってのに、香田は味気ない反応だった。俺のジャケットを摘んで離さないまま、しかしそれを隠すように俺のそばへ一歩寄った。
lines.english: Even though she'd run into friends she could relax around, Koda's response was flat. She kept hold of my jacket and stepped closer to my side, as if trying to hide it.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あら……？　元気ないのね、コーダイン……」
lines.english: “Oh, my... What's wrong, Kodine? You seem a little down...”

lines.japanese: ギャル男はひるんだ。さすがにこの張りつめた空気に気付いたようだ。体を斜め後ろに傾けて、同行者にささやく。
lines.english: The flashy one faltered. Even he had finally noticed the tension. He leaned backward at an angle and whispered to his companion.

lines.japanese: 「ヤベえ、なんか俺ら、ビミョーにウザがられてる気」
lines.english: “Crap. I'm getting the feeling they find us kind of annoying.”

lines.japanese: 「ビミョーじゃねえよ、ＭＡＸお呼びじゃねえってよ。だからやめとけッつったじゃねーか」
lines.english: “Kind of? They don’t want us here, period. Told you to leave them alone.”

lines.japanese: この平成ズッコケコンビの登場を、亜衣がどう思ったかは知らない。しかし俺は正直、助かったと思った。
lines.english: I had no idea what Ai made of these two modern-day clowns barging in. Personally, I was relieved.

lines.japanese: 「おう。何してんのおまえら」
lines.english: “Hey. What are you two doing here?”

lines.japanese: いつになく友好的なトーンで語りかける。一歩前へ出るとき、背中でジャケットが突っぱった。いつまで俺の服持ってる気だあいつ。
lines.english: I addressed them in an unusually friendly tone. When I stepped forward, the back of my jacket pulled taut. How long was she planning to hang on to me?

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああ、えと、ちょっとボウリングしてて、いまジュース買いに出てきたとこなんスよ、ハハ……」
lines.english: “Oh, uh, we were bowling, and we just came out to buy some drinks. Ha ha...”

lines.japanese: 「ふうん。そっちにボウリング場あったんだ」
lines.english: “Huh. Didn't know there was a bowling alley over there.”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 俺は連中が歩いてきた方角に目を凝らした。この界隈でもっともポピュラーなピースボウル柳木原店とは、まったくの逆方向だった。
lines.english: I peered in the direction they had come from. It was exactly opposite Peace Bowl's Yanagihara branch, the most popular alley in the neighborhood.

lines.japanese: 「え、ソレどの辺？　いつオープンしたの」
lines.english: “Where is it? When did it open?”

lines.japanese: 「や、それは……ハハ、どうだったかなぁ、ねえ……？」
lines.english: “Uh, well... Ha ha. When was it again? Hey...?”

lines.japanese: ギャル男がまた後ろの同行者に尋ねる。森里はバーカと無音で返したあと、俺に向かって溜息をつくような声で言った。
lines.english: The flashy one appealed to his companion again. Morisato silently mouthed *idiot*, then spoke to me in a voice like a sigh.

lines.japanese: 「ボウリングはいつものピースボウルだよ。ちょっとマズジュー探してこの辺まで足伸ばしてみたカンジ」
lines.english: “We bowled at the usual Peace Bowl. Then we came this way looking for some nasty soda to try.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そう」
lines.english: “Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: なんだあのロンゲ、ずいぶん機嫌悪そうだな。ほんとに怒ったり笑ったりアップダウンの激しいガキだ。
lines.english: What was up with that long-haired guy? He looked pissed. Kid really did bounce hard between angry and laughing.

lines.japanese: 「い、いや、俺らよりあの、隼人先輩たちは何してたんスか」
lines.english: “N-never mind us. What were you and Koda doing, Hayato?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ちょっと漫喫で調べモンして。もう帰るとこ──」
lines.english: “Oh, I had a little research to do at the comic-book café. We were just heading home—”

lines.japanese: ぐい、と後ろで服を引っぱられた。いや、不服があるなら口を開け。
lines.english: My clothes jerked backward. If you have an objection, use your words.

lines.japanese: 香田が会話に入ってこないから、俺はひとりでチャラ男ふたりを相手にしなければならない。
lines.english: Koda wasn’t joining in, so I had to fend off the two of them myself.

lines.japanese: 「おまえら知らねーだろ。あそこの漫喫、なかなかいいぞ。シートとか結構ふかふかだし、あと飲み放題のアレ、なんかジャーって出るやつから、日本人のソウルフード的なモン出てきちゃうの」
lines.english: “You guys probably don’t know this, but that comic-book café is pretty good. The seats are pretty plush. And that all-you-can-drink machine—the thing that goes *shhh*—it even serves something like Japan’s soul food.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　そんなん、いまどきどこのネカフェでもフツーだろ。知らねーのおまえくらいなんじゃね。相変わらず時間超越してんな、成田」
lines.english: “What? Every internet café has that these days. You’re probably the only one who doesn’t know. You seriously live outside of time, Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「うそつけテメ、シッタカこいてンじゃねえよ。結構ふかふかだぞ、そこらの平凡なふかふかと一緒にしてもらっちゃ困るんだよ」
lines.english: “Bullshit. Don't bluff like you know everything. Those seats are *pretty* plush. Don't lump them in with your ordinary, everyday plushness.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、そッスねえ。たしかにさっき座ったカンジ、結構ふかふか──」
lines.english: “Well, sure. When I sat in one earlier, it was pretty plush—”

lines.japanese: 「さっき座った？」
lines.english: “Earlier?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああいやいや、さっきじゃないさっきじゃない。えと、こないだ、こないだ座ったカンジ」
lines.english: “Oh, no, no, not earlier. Not earlier. Uh, the other day. When I sat in one the other day.”

lines.japanese: こいつら……なんか今日はシャベリが白々しいと思ったら、そういうことか。
lines.english: These two... So that was why everything they'd said sounded especially phony today.

lines.japanese: くそ、もしかして、香田との会話ぜんぶ聞かれてたわけじゃないだろうな。俺わりとハズいこと口走ってた気がするぞおい。
lines.english: Shit, don’t tell me they heard my whole conversation with Koda. I think I blurted out some pretty embarrassing stuff back there.

lines.japanese: もういやだ。青い春の大三角形に組みこまれるのはもう御免だ。尾行と盗聴は無罪放免にしてやるから、もう俺を逃がしてくれ。
lines.english: I’d had enough. No more being drafted into this teenage love triangle. I’d forgive them for following and eavesdropping; just let me out.

lines.japanese: 「じゃ俺バイト行くから。おまえらボウリング戻んだろ、こいつ連れてってやって」
lines.english: “I've got work. You two are going back to bowl, right? Take her with you.”

lines.japanese: そんで若者同士だけで青春しててくれ。もう余命いくばくもないおっちゃんを巻きこまないでくれ。
lines.english: Then they could go be young together. Leave the old man with one foot in the grave out of it.

lines.japanese: 「なんでおまえが保護者ヅラなんだよ」
lines.english: “Why are *you* acting like her guardian?”

lines.japanese: 「ハイハイ、いちいち絡まない。おう香田、ほら行け。この元気なおにいさんたちと一緒に遊んでこい」
lines.english: Yeah, yeah, quit picking at every little thing. Koda, go on. Go have fun with these energetic guys.

lines.japanese: 「いい。隼人君、駅まで送って」
lines.english: “No. Hayato, walk me to the station.”

lines.japanese: ぐいいっ。ジャケットが限界まで引っぱられた。森里の表情も引きつった。勘弁してくれ。
lines.english: *Jerk.* My jacket stretched to its limit. Morisato's face tightened along with it. Give me a break.

lines.japanese: 「な、なんだよコーダイン、もう帰っちゃうのかよ！　みんな待ってンぜ、ボウリングしちゃおうぜ、朝までスコーンと倒しまくっちゃおうぜ！」
lines.english: “What, Kodine? You're leaving already? Everybody's waiting! Come bowl with us. We'll keep knocking 'em down till morning!”

lines.japanese: 「おーホレ、あのおにいさんイイこと言ってんぞ。行ってこい、スコア表に黒い三角いっぱい並べてこい」
lines.english: “See? That nice young man has the right idea. Go fill the score sheet with little black triangles.”

lines.japanese: 俺は亜衣の脳天に二度三度チョップを落としたが、やつは子供みたいに唇を突きだして離れようとしなかった。
lines.english: I chopped Ai on top of the head two or three times, but she only stuck out her lower lip like a child and refused to let go.

lines.japanese: 「亜衣」
lines.english: “Ai.”

lines.japanese: 森里はデコ上から長い髪に手櫛を入れた。
lines.english: Morisato combed his long hair back from his forehead with his fingers.

lines.japanese: 「俺ら戻るけど。どうすんの、来んの来ないの」
lines.english: “We're heading back. What are you doing? Coming or not?”

lines.japanese: 香田が俺を見上げる。懇願するような目。
lines.english: Koda looked up at me, pleading with her eyes.

lines.japanese: 「隼人君……だめ？」
lines.english: “Hayato... you really can’t?”

lines.japanese: 俺は心を鬼にしてやつの手を振りほどいた。
lines.english: I hardened my heart and shook off her hand.

lines.japanese: 「しつけーよ、バイトだっつってんだろ。いい加減うぜえ」
lines.english: “Give it a rest. I told you I've got work. You're seriously getting on my nerves.”
“You bastard!”

lines.japanese: 瞬間、森里の手が俺の胸倉をつかんだ。驚いた。臨戦態勢ではなかったといえ、真正面からの攻撃にも関わらずかわせないほど速かった。
lines.english: In an instant, Morisato's hand seized my collar. That surprised me. I hadn't been ready for a fight, but even so, he'd moved too fast for me to evade an attack coming straight at me.

lines.japanese: やつはつかんだ拳を巻きあげて俺の体を引きよせる。
lines.english: He twisted his fist upward and hauled me toward him.

lines.japanese: 「ドＳかよ。言い方ってもんがあんだろ。どんだけ抉りゃ気が済むんだ」
lines.english: “What are you, some kind of sadist? There are ways to say things. How deep do you have to cut before you're satisfied?”

lines.japanese: 「カズ君！」
lines.english: “Kazu!”

lines.japanese: 「黙っとけ！　おまえが言えねえこと代わりに言ってやるから」
lines.english: “Stay out of it! I'll say what you can't say for yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「放せ。くせえよ」
lines.english: “Let go. You stink.”

lines.japanese: 青春くせえ。
lines.english: Stank of youth.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ何様だ、ええ？　いっつもタルそうな眼で世の中ななめに観て、必死に騒いでる人間あざ笑って！　欲しいもんのために震えながらはしゃいでるやつの気持ち、考えたことねえのかよ！」
lines.english: “Who the hell do you think you are? You’re always looking sideways at the world through those tired eyes, laughing at people desperate enough to make a scene! Have you ever thought how it feels to make a fool of yourself, trembling all the while, for something you want?”

lines.japanese: 「森里」
lines.english: “Morisato.”

lines.japanese: 羨ましい。俺は泣きてえよ。
lines.english: I envied him. I could have cried.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、いいやつだな」
lines.english: “You’re a good guy.”

lines.japanese: 他人のために熱くなるなんて格好いいこと、俺にはできねえよ。
lines.english: I could never do anything as admirable as burning with anger for somebody else.

lines.japanese: 「だから、そういうのがムカつくッつってんだろ！　俺らの真剣を、茶化すことしかできねえのか！　おまえ、亜衣がどんだけ勇気出したか分かってねえだろ！」
lines.english: “That! That's exactly what pisses me off! All you can do is make a joke of us when we're serious! You have no idea how much courage Ai had to work up!”

lines.japanese: 「カズ君やめて」
lines.english: “Kazu, stop.”

lines.japanese: 「そんなに他人が嫌いなら出てくんじゃねえよ、帰るとこあんだろ！　欠陥品！」
lines.english: “If you hate people that much, then stay away from them! You've got somewhere else to go, don't you? You defective bastard!”

lines.japanese: 「和馬。もういいだろ」
lines.english: “Kazuma. That's enough.”

lines.japanese: ギャル男が俺とロンゲのあいだに割りこんできた。優しいが容赦のない腕力で親友を引きはがす。
lines.english: The flashy one forced himself between me and the long-haired kid. With gentle but irresistible strength, he peeled his best friend away.

lines.japanese: 「隼人先輩は分かってるよ。俺らより強えーひとだから独りを選べるだけだ。根っこは同じだって。だろ？」
lines.english: “Hayato gets it. He's just stronger than we are, so he can choose to be alone. Deep down, we're the same. Right?”

lines.japanese: 同意を求められたが、質問が抽象的すぎる。でも否定はしたくなかった。俺は首を縦にも横にも振らず、顎の下にウメボシを作って斜めに夜空を仰いだ。
lines.english: He wanted my agreement, but the question was too abstract. I didn’t want to deny it, either. I neither nodded nor shook my head; I puckered my chin into a little prune and looked up at the night sky at an angle.

lines.japanese: 「はいカーット！」
lines.english: “And cut!”

lines.japanese: そしてやつは高らかに叫んだ。
lines.english: Then he shouted triumphantly.

lines.japanese: 「ぎゃはっ！　のゎーんつって、和馬ァ、おめーのキレ芸もいよいよ真に迫ってきたなあ！　ぷぷっ、なんだコーダインの顔、あいつ超ビビッてんしマジうけるわ！」
lines.english: “Ha! Just kidding! Kazuma, your angry-guy routine is getting seriously convincing! Pfft, look at Kodine's face. She totally bought it. This is hilarious!”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、なに……え、ネタ？」
lines.english: “Wait, what...? Was that a bit?”

lines.japanese: 「ったりめーじゃん！　んな、気付こうぜぇ～？　俺らの人生、端から端までどこ切ったってギャグよ？　どんなシリアスだって全部オチへの仕込みだっつーの！　なっ！」
lines.english: “Of course it was! Come on, you gotta catch on! Our whole lives are one long joke, no matter where you cut 'em! Any serious moment is only setting up the punch line. Right?”

lines.japanese: 「お、おお……まあ、な……」
lines.english: “Y-yeah... Sure...”

lines.japanese: 「いッや～、でもやっぱ、隼人先輩だけは引っかかンなかったわ。くっそ、これマジでいつかリベンジするけどね。でもとりま、コーダインのヘンな顔いただいたっつーことで、今回のドッキリは小・成・功～！」
lines.english: “Man, but Hayato was the one guy we couldn't fool. Damn it, I am absolutely getting revenge one day. But for now, we got that priceless face out of Kodine, so I'm calling this prank a modest success!”

lines.japanese: 「なぁーん！　ヘンな顔言ぅーなしー！」
lines.english: “Naaah! Don't call my face weird!”

lines.japanese: 「んじゃコーダイン、今日はもう解散すっけど、明日は遊べんだろ」
lines.english: “Anyway, Kodine, we're wrapping up for today. You can hang out tomorrow, right?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、うん……たぶん……」
lines.english: “Oh, yeah... Probably...”

lines.japanese: 「おっけ、ほんじゃ、あとでメール投げとくわ。気ィ付けて帰れよ」
lines.english: “Okay. I'll shoot you a message later. Get home safe.”

lines.japanese: 「うん……じゃあ、ばいばい」
lines.english: “Yeah... Bye.”

lines.japanese: 香田は去りぎわ俺へ一瞥をよこした。俺は無言で目つぶしピースを返した。
lines.english: As Koda left, she glanced back at me. I silently flashed her an eye-poke peace sign.

lines.japanese: 森里は下を向いてアスファルトを突ついていたから、最後に香田が謝るような視線を送っていたことには気付いていないだろう。
lines.english: Morisato was looking down and prodding the asphalt, so he probably missed the apologetic glance Koda sent him at the very end.

lines.japanese: 「ハイ、隼人先輩も！　バイトがんばってちょっさいよ～！」
lines.english: “Okay, you too, Hayato! Do your bestest at work~!”

lines.japanese: もう帰ってくれの婉曲表現だろう、ギャル男にタックルされた。押しだされるまま数歩後退したところで、やつがクリンチしながら素早く耳打ちしてきた。
lines.english: I got tackled by the flashy guy, probably his roundabout way of saying get lost. He shoved me back a few steps, then kept me in a clinch and quickly whispered in my ear.

lines.japanese: 「今日のはカンペキ自分のチョンボっス。和馬いやがってたのに、隼人先輩とコーダインの邪魔しねえとやべーつって、自分が強引にけしかけたんス。ハンパな真似してサーセンした」
lines.english: “Today was completely my screwup. Kazuma didn’t want to, but I told him we had to interrupt you and Kodine, then pushed him into it. Sorry for pulling that half-assed crap.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: しかしギャル男は、俺がなにか言いかえすより先に森里のもとへ駆けだしていった。
lines.english: But before I could answer, the flashy one had already run back to Morisato.

lines.japanese: 「おーっしゃ和馬ァ、ナンパしに行こうぜナンパ！　ＤカップしばりプロＮＧで！」
lines.english: “All right, Kazuma! Let's go pick up girls! D-cups only, no professionals!”

lines.japanese: 「ん……ああ、いや、ごめん……なんか今日は違うわ……」
lines.english: “Mm... Yeah. No, sorry... I'm just not feeling it today...”

lines.japanese: 「あそ？　したら海いこうぜ海。ＬＲさんにクルマ出してもらってぇ、みんなで崖の上並んじゃってぇ、朝陽に向かってバカヤローとか叫んじゃってぇ！　アそれか、ひたすら黙って波見つめちゃう系のノリもよくね？」
lines.english: “Yeah? Then let's go to the beach. We'll get LR to drive, line everybody up on a cliff, and scream ‘You bastaaard!’ at the sunrise! Or hey, how about we just stare silently at the waves? That kind of mood could be good too, right?”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ……なんか、悪りいな、気ィ遣わせちゃって……」
lines.english: “Ha ha... Sorry. I'm making you worry about me...”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　べつに遣ってねーけどさ」
lines.english: “Huh? I'm not worried.”

lines.japanese: 「でも、俺がミカにフラれたとき、おまえ一晩中グチ聞いてくれたじゃん。今だから言うけど、あんとき俺めっちゃ嬉しかったんだわ。すげえ救われたっつうか」
lines.english: “But when Mika dumped me, you listened to me complain all night, remember? I never said it then, but that made me really happy. Kind of saved me, you know?”
“Daisuke...”

lines.japanese: 「ん、いいぞ？　おう聞いてやる、言いたいことあんなら言っとけ？」
lines.english: “Mm. Go ahead. I'll listen. If you've got something to say, get it out.”

lines.japanese: <8>\「俺はまだフラれてねえよ！」
lines.english: “I haven't been dumped yet!”

lines.japanese: 「いって！　いてえなバカ、だってさっきの態度、アレ明らかにオメエ終わってンじゃねーか！」
lines.english: “Ow! That hurt, idiot! The way she treated you back there, you're obviously finished!”

lines.japanese: <8>\「終わってる言うなあ！」
lines.english: “Don't say I'm finished!”

lines.japanese: くせえ。
lines.english: They stank.

lines.japanese: 友情くせえ。
lines.english: Of friendship.

lines.japanese: ド突き合いながら遠ざかってゆくふたつの背中を、俺は森里が言うところのタルそうな眼で見送っていた。
lines.english: I watched them walk away, trading punches, with the same weary eyes Morisato had mocked.

lines.japanese: なんで俺がいつもこんな眼をしているか教えてやろうか？
lines.english: Want to know why my eyes always look like this?

lines.japanese: おまえらみたいな連中がまぶしくて仕方ないからだよ。
lines.english: Because people like you are so bright I can hardly bear to look at you.
